verdict.rationale: Intuit documents a QuickBooks Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks) with a handful of payroll workflows: viewing employee information, managing deductions, payslips, pensions, and workers' comp codes. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows API parity with the UI. Core UI capabilities such as running payroll, onboarding, timesheets and scheduling, tax filing, 1099s, benefits, and HR approval chains have no documented API coverage, and employee access appears to be view-only. Missing for 10: any parity claim, evidence of API support for running or approving payroll, onboarding and hiring, time tracking, tax and 1099 filing, benefits, document management, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
